svg.text: A. Moving Tools Inside input[] (use_responses_lite)
Top-level Prompt.tools = None; tool deltas append after cached conversation
Turn 1 Prefix (Deterministic UUIDv5 Identity)
[0] BaseInstructionsFragment id = "msg_" + UUIDv5(ns_thread, text)
[1] AdditionalTools (built-ins) id = "at_" + UUIDv5(ns_thread, json)
ns_thread = UUIDv5(NAMESPACE_OID, thread_id) -> retry & resume stable!
Turns 1..9 Conversation & Tool Outputs (62,000 Cached Tokens)
All GPU KV blocks [0..968] remain untouched when new MCP tools activate
Turn 10 Tail: User @-mentions Linear MCP Connector
• Emits IncrementalToolsHint developer notice
• Appends ResponseItem::AdditionalTools { role: "developer",
tools: [{ type: "namespace", name: "mcp__linear", tools: [changed_only] }] }
-> 62,000-token prefix = 100% KV hit; only +420 delta tokens prefilled!
• On disconnect: appends compact RemovedTools (namespace subsumption)
B. TopLevelToolsState Two-Level SHA-1 Diffing
core/src/context/world_state/top_level_tools.rs
1. Split Header vs. Member Canonical Hashing
• Strip "tools" array from namespace JSON -> hash header as H["ns"]
• Hash each member individually -> H["ns.member_i"] (sorted JSON SHA-1)
• Duplicate key? Immediately fails closed with ToolCollision(name)
2. Four-Branch Minimal Wire Emission
• H["ns.m"] != prev -> AdditionalTools with ONLY changed_members
• Only H["ns"] changed (0 member diffs) -> API forbids empty namespace
array! Emits text-only DeveloperInstructions (skips 30 tool schemas)
• Namespace removed -> collapses all "ns.*" into 1 namespace notice
3. OTel Telemetry & Empty-Catalog Invariant
• Tracks codex.tool.incremental_updates (added | removed | schema_changed)
• Records description byte histograms on schema_changed
• Persists Some(BTreeMap::new()) so empty != Absent on next step
